_about: Colour and detail rules for the LSM's 3D model. Edit here, then run: python tools/build_model.py "LSM Build Instructions". Rules are tried top to bottom against each mesh name of lsm.glb (made by assemble.py); the first match wins. A mesh whose rule names no colour takes its colours from the "atlas" file (colour-atlas-lsm.json, made by make_atlas.py): TechBox's published LSM Cadasio guide, solid by solid, and the MRA's atlas for the MRA's Nano. A rule that does name a colour is a house-library colour or a TechBox decision (see _notes). First draft, 19 Oct 2026: the colours listed under _notes.unconfirmed wait on Lee.

rules._about: the 64 acrylic LED stems (drawn in assemble.py from Cadasio's box: the stem's own CAD is not in Lee's files yet), white as published
the Nano Board: the MRA's model and the MRA's rule

the LED matrix, from the atlas; the region: the grey window of the LED under the header, which Lee's STEP has fused into the LED's white body (so it came out white: Lee, 19 Oct 2026); round, so that only the window takes it (a square box also took the white body round it); the literal atlas grey, so that it groups with the other 63 windows
the LED matrix's right-angle pin header, made in assemble.py from Lee's photographs (19 Oct 2026): its plastic body
the header's three pins, the pads at the board's edge and the solder on them

the electrolytic capacitor, as published: black can, silver caps at both ends (own y 0 is the top in the assembly) and the silver stripe over the negative leg, in j3. Painted by boxes in the mesh's own frame, not from the atlas: Cadasio's silver caps are copies 0.04 - 0.05 mm over the rounded ends, and the black faces left under them showed through the silver as black marks on the top (Lee, 19 Oct 2026)
the USB cable's A end: the MRA's model and rule
a jumper wire's male end: pin silver, housing black
a jumper wire's female end (the MRA's model)
the breadboard's protective backing, light grey as the published guide shows it

unconfirmed: Jumper wires light grey #cad1ee / purple #4e008e (published), the push button's leads red #ef3340 / black #2d2926 (published, the house pre-wired lead colours).
decided: The LED matrix's V+ jumper wire yellow #ffdc00 (the house yellow, as the MRA's), not the published white (20 Oct 2026: Lee, 'the light grey/blue is very close to the white wire color').

D2 plain wood on both faces, as the other walls (19 Oct 2026: Lee read the published guide's brown outer face as bad lighting on D2; Cadasio's brown is a 0.127 mm sheet laid over that face in SolidWorks, and Lee's newer D2 has none).
